Run a single simulation replicate at a fixed beta_community value

Source: R/time_varying_transmission_calibration.R
run_one_sweep_replicate.Rd

Helper for run_beta_sweep(). Builds the parameter list for one replicate and returns its final attack rate.

Usage

run_one_sweep_replicate(
  beta,
  seed,
  population,
  initial_S,
  initial_E,
  initial_I,
  initial_R,
  sim_time,
  household_ratio,
  workplace_ratio,
  school_ratio,
  leisure_ratio,
  model_params
)

Arguments

beta

beta_community value for this replicate

seed

Seed for this replicate, passed through to parameters_list$seed

population

Population size

initial_S, initial_E, initial_I, initial_R

Initial compartment counts

sim_time

Simulation length in days

household_ratio, workplace_ratio, school_ratio, leisure_ratio

Setting-specific beta ratios relative to beta_community

model_params

Base parameters list supplying natural history and other non-swept parameters

Value

Numeric scalar: final attack rate (fraction of population ultimately infected). Includes R, D, E, I_mild, and I_hosp compartments so the estimate is robust when sim_time is short and the epidemic has not fully resolved.

See also

Other calibration: generate_beta_sweep_plot(), generate_time_varying_beta_vectors(), get_R0_from_attack_rate(), get_beta_from_R0_finalsize(), get_sweep_result_from_source(), run_beta_sweep()
